property_summary: For every admissible input, the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true (call completes successfully) even when the callee executes a function selector that does not revert; the mutant that changes the selector to transfer(...) can call a callee that deliberately reverts for that selector, causing the overall call to revert (breaking the property) for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the called selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), altering the external call target method and its return behavior.
